headline: Rapid Valley Annihilation: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Rapid Valley Annihilation is projected #13 of 16 with a 535.20 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Colston Loveland, Quinshon Judkins, and Caleb Williams. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.
